mcq.q: Which sound does the Arabic letter ذ make?
mcq.explanation: The letter ذ makes the sound dh as in this.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence أَذْهَبُ إِلَى الْمَدْرَسَةِ يَوْمَ الِاثْنَيْنِ mean?
options: I go to school on Monday.
There are seven days in a week.
mcq.explanation: أَذْهَبُ إِلَى الْمَدْرَسَةِ يَوْمَ الِاثْنَيْنِ (adhhabu ilaa l-madrasa yawma l-ithnayn) means: I go to school on Monday.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "bread"?
mcq.explanation: خُبْزٌ (khubz) means bread.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence لَا تَلْعَبْ بِالسِّكِّينِ mean?
options: The chair is at the door.
The key is in the cupboard.
Do not play with the knife.
mcq.explanation: لَا تَلْعَبْ بِالسِّكِّينِ (laa talʿab bi-s-sikkiin) means: Do not play with the knife.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence فِي الْمَطْبَخِ طَاوِلَةٌ وَكُرْسِيٌّ mean?
options: On the table there is a cup.
In the kitchen there is a table and a chair.
mcq.explanation: فِي الْمَطْبَخِ طَاوِلَةٌ وَكُرْسِيٌّ (fii l-matbakhi taawila wa kursii) means: In the kitchen there is a table and a chair.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence مَا أَجْمَلَ الْبِيئَةَ mean?
options: The sun is in the sky.
And the rain is from the sky.
mcq.explanation: مَا أَجْمَلَ الْبِيئَةَ (maa ajmala l-bii'a) means: How beautiful the environment is!

mcq.q: What does the Arabic question mark ؟ tell the reader?
options: The voice rises at the end
mcq.explanation: A question ends with a rising voice.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence أَنَا بِخَيْرٍ، الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ mean?
options: I am well, thanks be to God.
mcq.explanation: أَنَا بِخَيْرٍ، الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ (anaa bi-khayr, al-hamdu lillaah) means: I am well, thanks be to God.

mcq.q: What is the name of the Arabic letter ق?
mcq.explanation: The letter ق is called qaaf.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word أَخٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: أَخٌ is read akh and means brother.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "eggs"?
mcq.explanation: بَيْضٌ (bayd) means eggs.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence أُحِبُّ الطَّعَامَ mean?
mcq.explanation: أُحِبُّ الطَّعَامَ (uhibbu T-taʿaam) means: I like food.

mcq.q: Which of these letters does NOT join to the letter after it?
mcq.explanation: raa joins only to the letter before it. So do alif, daal, dhaal, zaay and waaw.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "fish"?
mcq.explanation: سَمَكٌ (samak) means fish.

mcq.q: Why do people use pictures to communicate?
options: Pictures can be understood by people who speak different languages
mcq.explanation: A picture can carry a message without words.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word مَوْزٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: مَوْزٌ is read mawz and means bananas.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence الْبَيْتُ كَبِيرٌ mean?
options: On the table there is a cup.
In the kitchen there is a table and a chair.
mcq.explanation: الْبَيْتُ كَبِيرٌ (al-baytu kabiir) means: The house is big.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word الْيَوْمَ (al-yawm) mean?
mcq.explanation: الْيَوْمَ (al-yawm) means today.

mcq.q: Which is the best answer to kayfa haaluka?
mcq.explanation: The question asks how you are, so the answer says 'I am well, thanks be to God'.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word رِجْلٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: رِجْلٌ is read rijl and means leg.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word قَلْبٌ (qalb) mean?
mcq.explanation: قَلْبٌ (qalb) means heart.

mcq.q: In the game Simon Says, how do learners show they are listening?
options: They act only on the correct instruction
mcq.explanation: The game trains careful listening to instructions.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word شَايٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: شَايٌ is read shaay and means tea.

mcq.q: How do you read the syllable نَ?
mcq.explanation: نَ is read na.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence أَزُورُ جَدَّتِي يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ mean?
options: I help my mother on Saturday.
I read a book on Sunday.
I visit my grandmother on Friday.
mcq.explanation: أَزُورُ جَدَّتِي يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ (azuuru jaddatii yawma l-jumuʿa) means: I visit my grandmother on Friday.

mcq.q: What is blending?
options: Joining syllables or sounds together to read a word
mcq.explanation: Blending means saying the sounds one after another and joining them into a word.

mcq.q: What does the word al- do at the start of an Arabic word?
mcq.explanation: al- is the word for 'the', as in al-kitaab, the book.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence الْجَوُّ غَائِمٌ mean?
mcq.explanation: الْجَوُّ غَائِمٌ (al-jawwu ghaa'im) means: The weather is cloudy.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "I write with my hand."
mcq.explanation: أَكْتُبُ بِيَدِي (aktubu bi-yadii) means: I write with my hand.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word السَّبْتُ (as-sabt) mean?
mcq.explanation: السَّبْتُ (as-sabt) means Saturday.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "my turn"?
mcq.explanation: دَوْرِي (dawrii) means my turn.

mcq.q: Which is a good way to take care of the environment?
options: Plant trees and keep the surroundings clean
Cut trees without planting new ones
mcq.explanation: Planting trees and keeping the area clean protect the environment.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word أُذُنٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: أُذُنٌ is read udhun and means ear.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word جَوٌّ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: جَوٌّ is read jaww and means weather.

mcq.q: Which mark gives the short vowel 'i'?
options: Damma, a curl above the letter
fatHa, a line above the letter
kasra, a small line below the letter
mcq.explanation: kasra is written below the letter and gives the vowel i.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "rice"?
mcq.explanation: أَرُزٌّ (aruzz) means rice.

mcq.q: Which family word is written أُخْتٌ?
mcq.explanation: أُخْتٌ is ukht, sister.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "and upon you peace (the reply)"?
mcq.explanation: وَعَلَيْكُمُ السَّلَامُ (wa ʿalaykumu s-salaam) means and upon you peace (the reply).

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word أَنَا read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: أَنَا is read anaa and means I.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word قَلَمٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: قَلَمٌ is read qalam and means pen.

mcq.q: What does jism mean?
mcq.explanation: jism means body.

mcq.q: What is the ending of the letter ة in جَدَّةٌ called?
mcq.explanation: ة is taa marbuta and appears at the end of many feminine words.

mcq.q: How do you read the syllable بُو?
mcq.explanation: بُو is read buu.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "On the table there is a cup."
mcq.explanation: عَلَى الطَّاوِلَةِ كُوبٌ (ʿalaa t-taawilati kuub) means: On the table there is a cup.

mcq.q: What are verbal cues?
mcq.explanation: Verbal cues are the ways the voice shows meaning.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "beside"?
mcq.explanation: بِجَانِبِ (bijaanibi) means beside.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word تَفَضَّلْ (tafaddal) mean?
mcq.explanation: تَفَضَّلْ (tafaddal) means please, go ahead.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word مَطْبَخٌ (matbakh) mean?
mcq.explanation: مَطْبَخٌ (matbakh) means kitchen.

mcq.q: In which direction is Arabic written?
mcq.explanation: Arabic is written from right to left.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word بُرْتُقَالٌ (burtuqaal) mean?
mcq.explanation: بُرْتُقَالٌ (burtuqaal) means oranges.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word الثُّلَاثَاءُ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: الثُّلَاثَاءُ is read ath-thulaathaa' and means Tuesday.

mcq.q: How do you read the syllable لَ?
mcq.explanation: لَ is read la.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "My mother cooks."
mcq.explanation: أُمِّي تَطْبُخُ (ummii tatbukhu) means: My mother cooks.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "write"?
mcq.explanation: اُكْتُبْ (uktub) means write.

mcq.q: Which letters do NOT join to the letter after them?
options: alif, daal, dhaal, raa, zaay and waaw
mcq.explanation: These six letters join only to the letter before them.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "garden"?
mcq.explanation: حَدِيقَةٌ (hadiiqa) means garden.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "hand"?
mcq.explanation: يَدٌ (yad) means hand.

mcq.q: Which day is al-jumuʿa?
mcq.explanation: al-jumuʿa is Friday.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "I see with my eye."
mcq.explanation: أَنَا أَرَى بِعَيْنِي (anaa araa biʿaynii) means: I see with my eye.

mcq.q: What does lii ʿaynaani mean?
mcq.explanation: lii means I have and ʿaynaani means two eyes.

mcq.q: Which sentence means 'I drink milk'?
mcq.explanation: ashrabu means I drink and haliib means milk.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence عَلَى الطَّاوِلَةِ كُوبٌ mean?
options: On the table there is a cup.
In the kitchen there is a table and a chair.
In the kitchen there is a table.
mcq.explanation: عَلَى الطَّاوِلَةِ كُوبٌ (ʿalaa t-taawilati kuub) means: On the table there is a cup.

mcq.q: What is the name of the Arabic letter م?
mcq.explanation: The letter م is called miim.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence عِيدٌ مُبَارَكٌ mean?
options: May you be well every year.
Do you have a party? (to a boy)
mcq.explanation: عِيدٌ مُبَارَكٌ (ʿiid mubaarak) means: Blessed festival (Happy Eid).

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "stand up"?
mcq.explanation: قِفْ (qif) means stand up.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word حَلْوَى (halwaa) mean?
mcq.explanation: حَلْوَى (halwaa) means sweets.

mcq.q: Which sentence means 'Do you like bananas?'
mcq.explanation: hal makes a question and tuhibbu means 'you like'.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence أَشُمُّ بِأَنْفِي mean?
mcq.explanation: أَشُمُّ بِأَنْفِي (ashummu bi-anfii) means: I smell with my nose.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word فَمٌ (fam) mean?
mcq.explanation: فَمٌ (fam) means mouth.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word عَيْنٌ (ʿayn) mean?
mcq.explanation: عَيْنٌ (ʿayn) means eye.
